_doc: fc-single-016 (filesystem): move_file with src/dst; the prompt states the archive directory already exists, so no mkdir step is needed. Decoys are read_file and write_file. Tests picking move over copy/write and extracting both paths.
prompt: Move /var/log/app/app.log to /var/log/app/archive/app.log.2023-Q4. The archive directory should already exist.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the full text contents of a file at the given absolute path. Returns the file contents as a UTF-8 string, or an error if the file does not exist or is not readable.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write a UTF-8 string to a file at the given absolute path, overwriting any existing contents.

function.name: move_file
function.description: Rename or move a file or directory. Both paths must be absolute. Fails if `dst` exists.
